notes: Counts are package/advisory instances, not proven exploits.
API and web were rescanned after an observed deployment. Image IDs below identify the scanned versions.
Only the legacy controller used runtime rootfs because its original image was unavailable; its rootfs export omitted symlinks, special files, hardlinks and mounted volumes.
Registry npm audit covers local lockfiles. Runner OS and npm CLI dependencies are separate from the application lockfile.
Vendor severity and reachable code paths must be assessed; Trivy severity is preserved here.
